description: Collapsible sidebar navigation with icon-only collapsed state, optional named sections, nested child items, badge counts, a current-page marker and optional header/footer slots.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: Navigation items rendered as one ungrouped list, before any <see cref="Sections"/>.

parameters.name: Sections
parameters.description: Optional named groups of navigation items, each rendered under its own visible heading (h2) that also names the group's list through aria-labelledby. Null (the default) keeps the single ungrouped list, so existing markup is unchanged.

parameters.name: Collapsed
parameters.description: Whether the sidebar is in collapsed (icon-only) state.

parameters.name: OnToggle
parameters.description: Fires when the toggle button is clicked.

parameters.name: NavLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Null (the default) uses the localized "Sidebar navigation" — a host with more than one navigation landmark names this one after its purpose ("Product navigation").

parameters.name: AutoActive
parameters.description: When true, an item is shown as the current page when its Href matches the current location, in addition to its own IsActive. Default false: the host decides, exactly as before.

parameters.name: AutoActiveMatchMode
parameters.description: How AutoActive compares paths. SidebarNavMatchMode.Exact (default) marks only the page itself; SidebarNavMatchMode.Prefix also marks a parent entry for its sub-pages on a segment boundary (the root "/" entry stays exact in both modes).

parameters.name: CollapseTooltips
parameters.description: When true (the default) a COLLAPSED item renders a TmTooltip with its label, so the icon-only rail still tells a sighted user what an icon means. The accessible name is not optional: the link keeps its aria-label even with this turned off. Turning it off also keeps the collapsed nav a vertical scroll container, which a tooltip would need to escape.

parameters.name: Footer
parameters.description: Optional footer content (e.g. user info, version).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

usedAbstractions.name: SidebarNavItem
usedAbstractions.description: Model representing a navigation item in the sidebar

usedAbstractions.name: SidebarNavSection
usedAbstractions.description: Model representing one named group of navigation items

examples.title: Basic sidebar with navigation items
Sectioned sidebar that follows the current page
examples.code:
<TmSidebar Sections="sections"
           NavLabel="Product navigation"
           AutoActive="true"
           AutoActiveMatchMode="SidebarNavMatchMode.Prefix"
           Collapsed="railCollapsed"
           OnToggle="ToggleRail" />

examples.title: Icon-only rail without tooltips (keeps the vertical scroller)
